title: Peace Village Walker Tracker Fundraiser
author: Stephanie
body:
Earlier this year, staff at the APT Travel Group participated in the Resume Play Europe River Cruise (Jan/Feb 2022) Walker Tracker challenge, with the goal of raising money for Peace Village International (Friedensdorf International in Germany).

Since 1967, Peace Village have been working to provide medical attention to children living in war zones. The Germany based initiative, ensures children have access to treatment and physiotherapy in European hospitals and rehabilitate approximately 1,000 children each year through the program. They are then returned to their families and homes after healing.

Recently, Peace Village have been focusing on broadening their organised international charter flights throughout Afghanistan, Africa and Central Asia. Since the Covid-19 pandemic, Peace Village have had to switch their organised aid flights to regular/schedule flights to fly the sick and wounded children to Germany. Until recently, only children from Afghanistan and Angola are brought to Germany by these chartered flights.

With the staff’s generous donations and team spirit throughout the challenge, the APT Foundation was able to donate AUD$15,00 to Peace Village. They have been able to use this donation to help expand their charter flights, enabling children from Gambia, Uzbekistan and other hard to reach locations to receive urgent medical care. Most importantly, since the end of June, Peace Village have been able to fly 30 children back to their home country after their treatment had finished, reuniting them with family and friends.

The APT Foundation would like to extend a thank you to all who participated and donated so generously to help Peace Villages mission to provide medical attention to children living in areas of conflict. To learn more about Peace Village International and how you can support, visit our Peace International page.
